node tools/test-classify.mjs   # window-logic regressio

plugins.description: Stop & delete DeepSeek Harness sessions from the sidebar menu — cancels the running turn, subagents, background jobs and reminders, then removes the log, projection cache and workspace record. 「停止」与「删除」会话：先停工作，再删日志、缓存与工作区记录，并在有新版本时提示。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-session-remove **Stop and permanently delete sessions from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar — plus a notice when a new release is out.** **给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的会话菜单补上「停止」与「删除」，并在有新版本时提示更新。** [中文](#中文) · [English](#english) --- ## 中文 DSH 的会话行菜单只有 **重命名 / 分叉 / 归档** —— 归档只是把会话藏起来，日志一个字节都没少； 而想停掉一个会话的工作，你得先打开它、再按停止。这个插件把这两件事都放回你最常点的位置 （会话行的 `⋯` 菜单）。 ``` ⋯ 菜单 → 停止会话… 取消运行中的回合、子代理、后台任务与定时提醒 → 删除会话… 永久删除该会话的本地数据（不可恢复） ``` 安装后不需要重启 DSH，也不需要刷新页面。 ### 为什么不是又一个 DOM 补丁 同类插件普遍靠注入 DOM 或沿 React fiber 取行数据来塞菜单项，核心 UI 一改就可能失效。 本插件走的是官方开放的扩展点： - 菜单项注册进官方 slot **`sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`** —— Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive 本身就是这个 slot 里的注册项，插件行按 `order` 排序； - 停止走官方的 **`workspace/session-stop`** 准入（`ctx.workspaceRegistry.stopSessionActivity()`）， 由 `dsh-agent` / `dsh-subagent` / `dsh-jobs` / `dsh-schedule` 四个 provider 分别停掉回合、子代理、后台任务与提醒； - 删除通过 **`ctx.workspaceRegistry`** 与 **`storageDomain`** 的公开 API 完成，不 shell 出 `rm`； - 删完 emit 官方事件 **`api-session/removed`**（会话被销毁时会话控制器自己发的那条），侧栏该行当帧消失； - 只删能自证身份的目录：日志路径由持久化后端的 `locate()` 给出，并要求 `basename(dir) === sessionId`， 否则直接拒绝而不是猜。 ### 安装 ```sh # 桌面版：侧栏 → 插件 → 添加插件 → 填包名 dsh-session-remove # 其它 profile（web / tui / 自建） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-remove ``` > **中国用户注意**：如果你的 npm 默认源是 `registry.npmmirror.com`，新发布的包在镜像上可能有 > **同步延迟**。若安装时报「`declares no dsh.bundle`」，请在安装对话框里把**安装源**改成 > **npm 官方源**，或改用 tarball 地址： > `https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-session-remove/-/dsh-session-remove-<版本号>.tgz` 升级：本插件带更新提示（见下），也可以在插件页卸载后重新安装。 ### 用法 鼠标移到侧栏任意会话行 → 点 **⋯**： | 菜单项 | 做什么 | |---|---| | **停止会话…** | 取消运行中的回合，并停掉该会话的子代理、后台任务与定时提醒 | | **删除会话…** | 永久删除该会话的本地数据 | **停止的一个要点**：这条停止路径与归档用的是同一条（`workspace/session-stop`）， 它**丢弃排队中的输入**（界面上的停止按钮会保留）。确认框里写明了这一点。 **删除**遇到仍在跑的工作时，弹窗会说明原因并多给一个 **停止并删除** 按钮，一步完成。 ### 删除的是什么 | 位置 | 内容 | |---|---| | `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<项目>/<会话id>/` | 会话日志（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`）与写租约，整个目录移除 | | `session_projcache` 存储域 | 该会话的投影检查点记录 | | `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json` | 工作区成员位置、置顶、归档记录 | | 页面 | `api-session/removed` 事件让该行立即消失，无需刷新 | 搜索索引不需要额外处理：它按持久化列表对账，会话从列表消失即被清理。 ### 安全边界 | 情况 | 行为 | |---|---| | 仍有回合 / 子代理 / 后台任务 / 定时提醒 | 拒绝，并提供「停止并删除」 | | 停止后仍在收尾（有界等待内未清零） | 拒绝，提示稍候再试 | | 会话仍被进程持有 | 先释放它再删（见下） | **为什么删除前要先释放**：一个还活着的写句柄会在下一次 flush 时把刚删掉的日志重新创建出来。 注册表的归档流程把释放交给会话的登记方，而 seam 没给第三方留受支持的入口，所以插件调用 存储服务的公开方法 `detachEntered(entry)`，并在删除文件前跑一次持久化屏障： ``` 释放会话 → 停止工作 → 等待清零 → flush 屏障 → 删除文件 ``` 两处顺序都不能颠倒：**先释放再停止**，否则被停止的会话会唤醒 agent 去处理被杀任务的结果、 甚至重新启动新的工作，那份新工作会活过删除变成孤儿；**先释放再删文件**，否则写句柄会把日志写回来。 取不到释放凭据（不同版本）时会退化为拒绝并提示先切换会话——功能降级，但绝不会留下半删状态。 > 删除**当前正在查看**的会话后，主区域会自动回到空状态（与官方归档当前会话的行为一致）， > 不会停在已经不存在的旧页面。 ### 更新提示 插件会定期问一次注册表（默认 npm 官方源，失败回退 npmmirror）自己是不是最新版。 **只提示，不静默替换**：右下角出现一条可关闭的提示，点「更新」才通过 profile 自己的插件管理器 安装。替换已安装的包需要重启才能加载新的宿主模块，所以提示里会写明「重启后生效」。 包名取自自身的 `package.json`，默认即可工作；只有把包部署成别名时才需要覆盖 `updatePackageName`。 ### 工作原理 | 半边 | 文件 | 职责 | |---|---|---| | Host | `index.js` | 在 `/api` 鉴权围栏内注册 6 条精确 Fetch 路由：`session-delete.delete` / `.stop` / `.update-state` / `.install-update` / `.client-ready` / `.status` | | Client | `client.js` | 注册两个菜单项与一个 `shell.overlay` 条目（确认框 + 更新提示），中英双语跟随界面语言 | 浏览器半与宿主半同源通信，凭据由浏览器会话自动携带。 ### 兼容性 - 实测 DSH **0.2.0-rc.2**（DeepSeek Harness Desktop） - 需要组合里存在 `connection` / `sessionPersistence` / `workspaceRegistry`（Web profile 默认满足） - 零依赖、零构建 ### 排查 插件会写一行/次操作到 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-session-remove.log`： ``` host half active (build r5-unified@1.0.0, 6 routes, update mode notify) client half mounted (features=stop,delete,update+menu=sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item,overlay=shell.overlay) update check: current 1.0.0, latest 1.0.1 (update available) stop session-…: asked job (settled: true) released session-… from the live store deleted session-… (session-dir:…, projection-cache) refused session-…: session-held ``` - 没有 `client half mounted` → 页面半没装载（检查插件是否启用、页面是否刷新过） - `refused : ` → 宿主拒绝了这次操作，代码含义见「安全边界」 - 安装时报 `declares no dsh.bundle` → 见「安装」里的镜像同步说明 ### 已知限制 - **删除不可恢复**：没有回收站，也没有撤销。 - 附件是内容寻址去重的，不做按会话回收。 - 删除**正被界面打开**的会话时会被先释放（主区域回到空状态）。 - 「停止」会丢弃排队中的输入，这是它所复用的官方停止路径的语义。 - 更新需要重启才生效；旧版本的宿主模块会一直留在内存里直到重启。 ### 测试 零依赖，用 Node 内置的测试运行器（Node ≥ 22）： ```sh node --test test/host.test.mjs test/client.test.mjs # 41 项 ``` `test/host.test.mjs`（28 项）用模拟的 `ctx` 驱动真实的 `apply()`：删除与停止的完整链路、 释放顺序、拒绝码、路径护栏、更新检查的每条分支与 semver 排序。 `test/client.test.mjs`（13 项）用最小 React 运行时真实渲染两个菜单项、两个确认框与更新提示， 模拟点击并核对请求载荷与文案。 测试**不会**进入 npm 包（`files` 白名单里没有 `test/`），只随仓库分发。 --- ## English DeepSeek Harness's session row menu only offers **Rename / Fork / Archive** — archiving hides a session but keeps every byte on disk, and stopping a session's work means opening it first and pressing Stop. This plugin puts both back where you already click: the session row's `⋯` menu. ``` ⋯ menu → Stop Session… cancels the running turn, subagents, background jobs and reminders → Delete Session… permanently removes that session's local data (no undo) ``` No DSH restart and no page reload needed after installing. ### Why not another DOM patch Comparable plugins inject DOM nodes or walk React fibers to add a menu row, so a change to the core UI can break them. This one uses open extension points only: - the row registers into the official slot **`sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`** — Pin / Rename / Fork / Archive are registered entries in that same slot, so a plugin row is ordered by its own `order`; - stopping goes through the official **`workspace/session-stop`** admission (`ctx.workspaceRegistry.stopSessionActivity()`), answered by `dsh-agent` / `dsh-subagent` / `dsh-jobs` / `dsh-schedule` for the turn, subagents, background jobs and reminders; - deleting uses the public **`ctx.workspaceRegistry`** and **`storageDomain`** APIs — it never shells out to `rm`; - the deletion emits the official **`api-session/removed`** event (the one the Session controller itself emits when a live Session is disposed), so the row disappears on the spot; - only a directory that can prove its identity is removed: the log path comes from the persistence backend's `locate()`, and `basename(dir) === sessionId` must hold, or the plugin refuses instead of guessing. ### Install ```sh # Desktop: sidebar → Plugins → Add plugin → enter the package name dsh-session-remove # Other profiles (web / tui / custom) dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-remove ``` > **Behind the npmmirror registry?** A freshly published package can lag on the mirror. If the > install refuses with `declares no dsh.bundle`, switch **Install source** to the official npm > registry in the dialog, or install the tarball URL > `https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-session-remove/-/dsh-session-remove-.tgz`. Upgrading: this plugin offers an update notice (below), or uninstall and reinstall in the Plugins page. ### Usage Hover any session row in the sidebar → click **⋯**: | Menu row | What it does | |---|---| | **Stop Session…** | cancels the running turn and stops that session's subagents, background jobs and reminders | | **Delete Session…** | permanently removes that session's local data | **One thing to know about stopping**: this is the same path archive uses (`workspace/session-stop`), and it **discards queued input** (the in-conversation stop button keeps it). The confirmation dialog says so. When a **delete** meets running work, the dialog explains why and offers a **Stop and delete** button that does both in one step. ### What gets deleted | Location | Content | |---|---| | `$DSH_HOME/sessions///` | the session log (`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`) and its write lease — the whole directory | | the `session_projcache` storage domain | that session's projection checkpoint record | | `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json` | workspace membership, pin and archive entries | | the page | the `api-session/removed` event removes the row without a reload | The search index needs no help: it reconciles against the persistence listing, so a session that leaves that listing leaves the index too. ### Safety boundaries | Situation | Behaviour | |---|---| | A turn / subagent / background

plugins.description: Keeps the DeepSeek Harness context-usage ring honest: an empty usage sample during a retry no longer collapses it to 0%, and its percentage matches the figures beside it.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-context-usage-guard

Keeps the DeepSeek Harness composer's context-usage ring honest: an empty usage
sample during a retry no longer collapses it to `0%`, and its percentage is
typeset at the size of the figures beside it.
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/releases/tag/v0.2.0)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-context-usage-guard/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.17-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh)
plugin that repairs two defects in the composer's **context-usage ring** — one in
the value it shows, one in how large that value is drawn:

1. the ring stops dropping to `0%` while a model request is being retried — the
   host half; and
2. the ring's percentage renders at the size of every other figure on its own
   line — the browser half, one stylesheet rule.

## The two bugs it repairs

```
One line, in the composer footer:

  182 steps · 238 tok/s      33.4M tok · Cache hit 94%      ◯ 30%
                                                             ↑
              the ring's 30% was one pixel larger than every other figure

Mid-retry, the same ring read 0% instead of holding the last real reading:

  ◯ 0%   →   ◯ 6%
```

### The ring collapses to `0%` while a request is being retried

The ring renders the session projection `contextPressure`. That projection takes
the **newest usage sample** as the current prompt size and publishes:

```text
pressureTokens  = usage.inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens
projectedTokens = max(0, pressureTokens + surfaceTokens - sampledSurfaceTokens)
```

A model call that fails before the provider reports anything — a `429`, a rate
limit, a timeout, a transport error, or a user cancellation — still ends its
stream with a `usage` chunk:

```jsonc
[ { "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "usage",  "usage": { "inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 0, "totalTokens": 0 } } },
  { "type": "chunk", "chunk": { "type": "finish", "reason": { "kind": "error",
      "failure": { "code": "RATE_LIMIT", "message": "429: token_capacity_exceeded" } } } } ]
```

The adapter's accumulator starts at zero and nothing ever overwrote it, so this
sample is *empty*, not a measurement. But it is the newest sample, so
`pressureTokens` becomes `0`, and because the sample is stamped at the current
surface total the projection publishes `projectedTokens: 0`. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`
then retries the same step — six times in the session this plugin was written
from — and the ring reads `0%` for the whole storm, misreporting a context that
never changed.

Measured against the shipped `contextPressure` fold, replaying that session's
real events (`test/fold.spec.ts`):

| Replay | `pressureTokens` | `projectedTokens` | Ring |
|---|---|---|---|
| after the last successful call, before the retry | 64 389 | 64 389 | `6%` |
| the failed attempt, **unguarded** | 0 | 0 | `0%` ← the symptom |
| the failed attempt, **guarded** | 64 389 | 64 389 | `6%` |
| the retried step finally succeeds | 64 575 | 64 575 | `6%` |

### The percentage is one pixel larger than the figures beside it

The same footer band holds the session statistics and the ring, and the two
shipped stylesheets disagree by one pixel about how big a figure is:

```css
/* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat — StatsPills.module.css, the pills */
.bOPqQW_root    { font-size: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) - 1px) }

/* @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation — ContextMeter.module.css, the ring */
.JObwrW_trigger { font-size: var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) }
```

Both prefixes are content-hashed per build — the pair above is what the
`0.2.0-rc.2` packages installed here carry; the *declarations* are what matters,
and `test/meter-typography.spec.ts` re-reads them from the installed packages
rather than trusting this block.

So `30%` renders about 8% larger than the `182 steps`, `238 tok/s`, `33.4M tok`
and `Cache hit 94%` beside it, which reads as a different typeface. Measured on a
screenshot of that line: every other figure has a 12 px cap height, the ring's
has 13–14 px — a ratio of 1.08, exactly `13 ÷ 12`. The meter's own breakdown
panel is already `12px`, so the trigger is the outlier.

## What the plugin does

| Half | Surface | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `llm/stream` waterfall | one listener that withholds an empty usage sample belonging to a failed attempt, so the projection keeps its last real reading |
| Browser | the document `head` | one self-tagged stylesheet rule that puts the meter's percentage at the statistics pills' figure size |

Neither half adds a page, a route, a settings section or a stored file. The host
half declares `inject: ['llm']`, so the LLM service must exist first, and it
registers inside `ctx.effect`: cordis runs the disposer on unload, when the
profile patch disables the row, or at shutdown — a bare `ctx.on` would leak the
listener past unload.

One rule, applied to the chunk stream of every model call:

> A usage sample whose **every reported count is zero** measures nothing. When it
> belongs to an attempt that ended in `error` or `aborted`, it is dropped, so the
> previous real reading stands.

Everything else passes through untouched:

- **a successful completion**, whatever it reports — `stop`, `tool-calls` and
  `max-tokens` are authoritative provider answers, so a zero there is left for
  the consumer to judge;
- **a failed attempt that did report something** — a partial call can carry real
  input counts, so no billed counter is ever discarded;
- **stream shape, order and timing** — the withheld sample is the only chunk that
  moves; visible deltas keep their order and the terminal `finish` the retry
  executor reads is preserved.

## How the fix works

### Host half: the sample that decides the reading never lands

The wrapper holds **at most one** `usage` chunk and releases it immediately
before the next chunk, so the only chunk whose position can change is the sample
that decides the outcome. A stream that ends without its terminal `finish` still
releases a held sample — the guard never swallows information it did not
positively decide to drop. Withholding the chunk is legal in the stream protocol:
`usage` may appear at most once and is never required, `BlockAssembler.usage`
stays `undefined` without it, and the agent loop already omits the durable
event's `usage` field rather than failing. Token accounting is unaffected — the
projection's usage fold adds an empty sample's buckets as zero anyway, which
`test/fold.spec.ts` pins directly.

### Browser half: one stylesheet rule

The browser half adds one stylesheet rule that repeats the statistics
declaration verbatim:

```css
button[aria-haspopup="dialog"]:has(> svg > circle) {
  font-size: calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary,13px) - 1px);
}
```

- **Structural selector, not a class name.** The meter's button is the only
  dialog-opening control whose icon *is* the ring — an inline `<svg>` with
  `<circle>` children — while the statistics pills draw `<path>` icons. A build
  that re-hashes every class

plugins.description: Get记忆插件：DSH 的外置大脑——对话开始自动拉取 GitHub 仓库内容注入上下文，对话结束提取值得长期记住的新信息按文件写回并提交；左栏面板 + 原生设置页全图形化配置。Get 记忆 + Git 记忆。
plugins.readme_text:
# Get记忆（dsh-get-memory）— DSH 记忆插件

给 DeepSeek Harness 配一个「外置大脑」：对话开始前，它把 GitHub 仓库里的记忆文件装进上下文的脑子；对话结束后，它把值得长期记住的新事写回仓库并提交。跨设备、跨前端、跨重启，记忆都活在同一份文件里。

名字是个双关：**Get** 记忆（取回记忆）+ **Git** 记忆（GitHub 仓库里的记忆）。

## 快速开始（装好就能跑）

1. 安装插件（插件市场搜 `dsh-get-memory`，或 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-get-memory`）；
2. 生成细颗粒度 PAT：**只勾目标仓库的 Contents 读写**，别的权限一律不选（旧仓库、空仓库、新仓库都行）；
3. 打开左栏「Get记忆」面板（或设置页）→ 粘贴令牌 → 保存 → 插件自动列出令牌能看到的仓库 → **单选一个**作为记忆仓库；
4. 空仓库？设置页点「**一键初始化**」——插件自己用令牌创建 `长期记忆账本.md`，不用你去 GitHub 手动建任何东西；
5. 正常聊天：对话开始自动读；想开自动写回再打开「自动写回」开关（默认关，保护你的模型额度）。

没选仓库之前，插件不注入任何东西、也不写回任何东西——陌生的默认配置零风险。

## 它到底在干嘛

打个比方：你有一个 GitHub 仓库，里面躺着几份 Markdown 文件——人设、规则、长期记忆账本，随便你写什么。这个插件就是那个仓库的「管家」：

- **每次对话开始**（新建或恢复会话），管家自动把仓库里的文件拉下来，注入当前对话的上下文——所以模型一睁眼就知道「我是谁、发生过什么、有什么约定」；
- **每次对话结束**（回合停摆 30 秒，或会话关闭），管家自己调用模型，从刚才的对话里挑出「值得长期记住的新信息」，按文件写好、取最新 SHA、提交回仓库。没有实质变化就什么也不动；
- 断网了也不慌：拉取失败自动回退磁盘缓存，绝不把对话搞崩。

> 适配说明：本插件只适配 **DSH 软件端**（桌面应用）。DSH 的网页界面是软件端的镜像页面，插件能力跟随软件端生效，不提供独立的 web 插件。

## 特性

- 🧠 **自动拉取注入**：对话开始自动拉取指定仓库文件注入上下文（排序号默认 100，位于所有运行时上下文之前）；注入内容自动花括号消毒，仓库文件里带 `{{User}}` 这类模板语法也不会炸。
- 🗂️ **文件权限中心**：设置页「同步文件列表」一键拉取仓库当前文件，每个文件「只读 / 读写」可视化勾选（新文件默认读写）；「注入读什么、写回写什么」全由这张表说了算。每次拉取还会自动盘点——新文件自动加入，含模板语法的自动跳过。
- ✍️ **多文件自动写回**：对话结束提取「值得长期记住的新信息」，对所有「读写」文件逐个产出变更、逐个 SHA 锁提交；某文件冲突就重取重试一次。跨端「传话文件」也支持——只在有需要传话/回话时才动它，绝不灌水。
- 💗 **左栏快捷面板**：一颗小心心图标，实时看拉取状态、写回结果、令牌状态，一键「立即拉取」，自动写回开关，内置最近操作记录。
- ⚙️ **原生设置页（宁少勿多）**：DSH 设置里新增「Get记忆」专属页面——令牌、仓库选择器（由令牌驱动的仓库列表，单选）、文件权限、自动写回、触发范围、全局提示；高级字段（分支、注入顺序、转录上限、提取模型等）藏在底层配置里，不干扰新手。
- 🔁 **触发与范围**：每 N 次对话写回一次（N 可填，1 = 每次）；应用于「全部会话 / 排除列表 / 仅列表」。
- 🛡️ **安全默认**：默认仓库为空、默认不自动写回；不配置就不会注入/写回任何东西；令牌只用于你自己选的仓库。
- 🧰 **一键初始化**：选了个空仓库？设置页点一下，插件自动创建 `长期记忆账本.md`（友好模板），全程不用碰 GitHub 网页——工具适应人，不让人适应工具。
- 🔄 **检查更新**：设置页「检查更新」实时读 npm 最新版本，对照当前版本给提示和一条更新命令。
- 🔔 **回合写回指示 + 全局小条**：每回合结束，消息下方一行小字——「记忆已写回 ✓ / 整理中… / 无新记忆 / 写回失败」，悬停看详情；输入框下方的小胶囊全程跟踪写回——整理中常驻（橙色呼吸点，直到写完）、提交后「记忆已更新 ✓」、没有新内容则灰点「无新记忆」。都能在设置里关。

## 原理

### 令牌是怎么用的

插件按以下顺序找令牌，找到即止：

1. **DSH 凭据库**（`AIRE_MEMORY_GITHUB_TOKEN`，面板保存的令牌就存在这里，推荐位置）；
2. **环境变量**（同名）；
3. **插件配置的 `githubToken` 字段**（引导用：一旦在配置里填了，插件首次加载时自动把它迁移进凭据库）。

令牌只会被用于「读取 / 写入你配置的那一个仓库」，**绝不写入仓库任何文件**；写回前还会对内容做密钥形态脱敏。

### 读取链路

`agent/created` 事件（每次「上岗」）→ 并行拉取仓库文件（GitHub Contents API）→ 更新内存缓存 + 磁盘缓存（`~/.dsh/cache/aire-memory/snapshot.json`）→ 通过 `systemPrompt.context()` 在每次模型组装时注入最新内容。拉取失败不报错：回退缓存（标注过期），缓存也没有就注入「暂不可用」占位。

### 写回链路

`agent/turn-stopping`（回合结束）→ 防抖 30 秒（期间有新消息就取消）→ 或 `agent/disposed`（会话关闭）立即执行 → 插件自行调用模型（用当前会话模型 / 默认模型）提取新记忆，按「读写」文件逐个产出更新后的完整内容 → **先 GET 拿最新 SHA** → **PUT 提交（SHA 锁）** → 409 冲突自动重取重试一次 → 成功后本会话立刻看到新内容。

只对**根会话**（主对话）写回；子代理 / 工作流会话不写。所有失败仅记日志，绝不打断对话。

### 界面分工：左栏快捷面板 vs 原生设置页

| 左栏快捷面板（日常用） | 原生设置页（详细配置） |
|---|---|
| 状态一览（仓库 / 令牌 / 最近修改记录） | 令牌、仓库选择器、文件权限、一键初始化 |
| 立即拉取 | 自动写回、触发与范围、全局提示模式 |
| 自动写回开关 | 检查更新、关于 / 问题反馈 / 更新记录 |
| 设置引导 | 设置引导 |

## 配置（均有默认值，可直接用）

设置页只露新手需要的字段；下表是完整配置（含底层字段，插件列表的配置入口可改）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `repo` | 空 | 记忆仓库（owner/repo）；留空 = 未配置，不注入不写回。设置页通过令牌选择 |
| `branch` | `main` | 分支 |
| `fileModes` | 旧字段自动迁移 | 文件权限表 `[{file, mode: 'ro'/'rw'}]`：注入取全部，写回只取 rw；设置页「文件权限」卡片管理 |
| `ledgerFile` | `长期记忆账本.md` | 主账本（多文件写回时排最前） |
| `injectOrder` | `100` | 上下文排序（数字小靠前；运行时上下文从 110 起） |
| `tokenRef` | `AIRE_MEMORY_GITHUB_TOKEN` | 凭据库 / 环境变量名 |
| `githubToken` | 空 | 引导令牌（secret），首次加载自动迁移进凭据库 |
| `autoDiscoverFiles` | `true` | 每次拉取盘点仓库新 .md 并加入权限表（读写），含 `{{` 模板语法的跳过 |
| `writebackEnabled` | `false` | 自动写回开关（默认关，保护模型额度） |
| `writebackEveryN` | `5` | 每 N 条对话写回一次记忆（1 = 每条都写） |
| `sessionPolicyMode` | `all` | 应用范围：`all` / `exclude` / `include` |
| `sessionPolicyIds` | 空 | 排除 / 仅限的会话 id 列表 |
| `maxWriteFiles` | `5` | 每次写回最多处理的「读写」文件数 |
| `writebackDebounceMs` | `30000` | 回合结束后的写回防抖（毫秒） |
| `maxTranscriptChars` | `16000` | 送入提取器的转录上限（取尾部） |
| `minConversationChars` | `80` | 低于此长度不提取 |
| `extractProvider` / `extractModel` | 空 | 提取模型覆盖；留空用会话模型 / 默认模型 |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `15000` | 拉取 / 写入超时（毫秒） |
| `showPanelIcon` | `true` | 显示左栏快捷面板图标 |
| `showTurnIndicators` | `true` | 显示回合写回指示 |
| `showGlobalNotice` | `true` | 写回变动时输入框下方的小条提示 |
| `historyLimit` | `50` | 面板内操作记录保留条数 |

设置页与快捷面板里改动以上任意字段（图标/指示开关除外）都会保存为运行时覆盖，即时生效、重启保留。

## 更换令牌

1. GitHub 生成新的细颗粒度 PAT（仅目标仓库 Contents 读写）；
2. 面板或设置页令牌框粘贴新令牌保存（自动覆盖凭据库旧值，保存时即做仓库读验证），或直接改 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` 里 `AIRE_MEMORY_GITHUB_TOKEN` 的值（重启 DSH 后生效）；
3. 旧令牌在 GitHub 上单独作废，互不影响。

## 本地开发

```bash
# 客户端半边是拼接式 ModuleLoader bundle（无构建依赖）：
node scripts/build-client.mjs   # 由 src/client/*.js 生成 client.js
node --check lib/index.v8.js    # 宿主半边语法检查
```

宿主半边入口见 package.json 的 `main`（纯 JS ESM）；客户端半边声明见 `dsh.client` 与 `exports["./client"]`。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: ADHD-friendly output style for DeepSeek Harness: a system-prompt hook, a live switch, and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-adhd-mode

ADHD-friendly output style for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). It puts a ruleset in the system prompt that makes replies easier to act on: the next action first, numbered steps, state restated each turn, no preamble. You can switch it on and off while a session is running.

A port of [ayghri/i-have-adhd](https://github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd) (MIT). The ruleset in `skills/adhd-mode/rules.md` is upstream's text with one paragraph replaced: upstream is turned off when the reader says a phrase, and this bundle has no phrase to say ([what changed](#changes-from-upstream)).

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md)

## What this replaces

Upstream is a set of glue scripts, one per runtime. On Claude Code it registers a `SessionStart` hook that pastes the ruleset into the session, and keeps an "always on" flag file at `~/.claude/.i-have-adhd-always`. DSH has no session-start hook, so all three pieces live in one bundle here:

| Piece | Upstream | Here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| hook | `SessionStart` hook | an `agent.ctx`-scoped `systemPrompt.section()` with a dynamic `text` |
| switch | flag file under `~/.claude/` | a `.volatile()` config field, live and persisted |
| page | none | a settings page and an icon+label trigger in the composer tool row |

## Changes from upstream

One paragraph of the ruleset is not upstream's: `## Persistence`. Upstream turns the mode off when the reader says "stop adhd mode", and its `SessionStart` hook re-pastes the ruleset whenever a session starts, resumes or compacts. Neither can happen here — the Host half matches no text — so that paragraph now says the switch lives outside the conversation and that nothing said in the conversation changes the mode. Everything else in `skills/adhd-mode/rules.md` is upstream's text, frontmatter included; the `disable-model-invocation` flag is inert because this bundle never registers the file as a skill.

Upstream's ruleset moves slowly (the project is mostly per-runtime glue), so there is no sync workflow: this copy is a fork, edited by hand.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:letterk/dsh-adhd-mode
```

That is the whole install. `dsh plugin` forwards the rest of the line to pnpm inside the profile, and the next boot promotes any new dependency that declares `dsh.bundle` to a profile layer on its own — there is no second step. Restart the profile afterwards.

Other specs pnpm accepts:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-adhd-mode
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-adhd-mode
```

The name `dsh-adhd-mode` is free on npm, but this project is not published there, so install by repository spec.

Installing from a working tree you intend to edit takes one extra step: see [live-edit install](#live-edit-install).

## Use

Two places, both in the Web UI:

| Where | What |
| --- | --- |
| the `ADHD` button in the composer tool row | click to flip |
| Settings → ADHD output mode | the switch on the page |

The change lands on the next model step and is written to the profile's config, so it survives a restart. There is no command, no tool and nothing to type — the UI is the only control, and the only place to look when the mode is not doing what you expected.

The switch is profile-wide, not per session. DSH's `PromptSection` takes no session key, so there is nowhere to store whether the mode was on in one particular session.

What *is* scoped is the injection. The section is registered on the agent's own context rather than the plugin's, so the ruleset reaches the agent the reader is talking to and stops there. A delegated child — anything spawned with a delegation depth, which includes Agent Teams teammates — joins its parent's preset and assembles with its own persona and tool set, never with this section. A session forked from another is a top-level agent the reader opened on purpose, so it does get the section.

## Config

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `false` | volatile; the switch the UI writes |
| `order` | `15` | position of the section in the system prompt |

## Files

```
index.js                        host half: the system-prompt hook
client.js                       client half: composer trigger and settings page
cordis.patch.yml                loader row that inserts the plugin
skills/adhd-mode/rules.md       the ruleset, from upstream
locale/{en,zh}.json             bundle title and description
icon.svg                        bundle icon
test/host.mjs                   host self-test
test/client.mjs                 client self-test, stub React
test/loader-hooks.mjs           points the schemastery import at the stub in a bare checkout
test/schemastery-stub.mjs       minimal stand-in for @deepseek-ai/schemastery
scripts/release.mjs             version bump, changelog freeze, tag; CI uses verify/notes
```

## Versions

[Semantic versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html). The compatibility surface is small — the loader row id and the settings namespace, the two strings a profile stores — so the rules are about what an existing install would have to do:

| Bump | When |
| --- | --- |
| MAJOR | an install has to be redone: the loader row id or the settings namespace changes, a config field disappears, or the bundle needs a newer DSH |
| MINOR | the reader gets something new, or the injection changes: a new seat, a new config field, a new language, a different prompt section |
| PATCH | a fix nobody has to react to: ruleset wording, docs, tests, internal refactors |

`package.json` holds the version, `CHANGELOG.md` records what is in it, and `[Unreleased]` accumulates until it is frozen. Cutting a release is one command:

```sh
npm run release -- patch    # or minor / major
```

That bumps the version, turns the `[Unreleased]` entries into a dated section, runs the tests, commits, and pushes the tag. `.github/workflows/release.yml` then publishes the GitHub release from that section. CI refuses a tag that disagrees with `package.json`, and a `doctor` job refuses a version that no changelog section explains.

The plugin market reads the version out of `package.json`, so the number here is what a listing shows. This project is not published to npm, so nothing depends on the number for resolution — but the tag is the only immutable pointer to "the code a reader had".

## Development

```sh
npm test
```

`test/host.mjs` loads `index.js` against a fake Cordis context and checks that exactly one section registers per top-level agent, that a delegated child gets none while a fork still gets one, that the ruleset appears only while the switch is on, and that the Host half exposes no command, tool or phrase matching. `test/client.mjs` loads `client.js` against stub browser globals and a stub React, then renders both seats in `zh` and `en`.

Neither test needs DSH, a browser, or `npm install`.

The host test uses the real `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` when it resolves, and `test/schemastery-stub.mjs` when it does not — which is the case in CI, a fresh clone, and any checkout without the profile's packages linked in. Take the stub path on purpose with:

```sh
DSH_ADHD_MODE_STUB=1 npm test
```

### Live-edit install

`file:` installs a copy, so the profile keeps the revision it was installed from. To have the profile read your working tree directly, link it instead:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-adhd-mode
```

A linked bundle is imported from its own directory, so its bare imports resolve there and not in the profile. Give the checkout a `node_modules` that reaches the harness packages:

```sh
cd /path/to/dsh-adhd-mode
mkdir -p node_modules
ln -sfn ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai node_modules/@deepseek-ai
```

Without it the row installs and then fails to import: `Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'`. The link is in `.gitignore`, so a fresh clone has to repeat this once.

`client.js` is not hot-reloaded in every setup; reload the Web UI page after editing it.

Live inspection, from a session inside the harness:

```
cordis_inspect_query host/Config  listConfigs  {"entry":"include:adhd-mode"}

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-compat-check

> 体检你**已经装了的** DSH 插件与**当前 DSH 版本**是否兼容；不兼容的，给出**位置**（`file:line`）和**原因**。

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) | [한국어](README.ko.md)

---

## 它回答什么

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）是「万物皆插件」的 agent harness：模型、工具、沙箱、界面、甚至 agent loop 本身都是插件。生态很大，而**插件的声明不等于宿主的现实**。

它只有一个问题要答：

> **我这一版 DSH 上，我已经装的那些插件，到底还能不能用？**

能用的地方不说废话；不能用的地方，必须给出**哪一行、为什么**。

### 四类误判，都在本项目里真实遇到过

| 你可能会以为 | 实际情况 |
|---|---|
| `peerDependencies` / `dsh.compatibility` 写了支持 → 能用 | **声明可能是错的。** 有插件声明支持 `0.2.0`，实测启动即抛 `ctx.settings.register is not a function` |
| DSH 的版本闸门放行了 → 能用 | 闸门只做**字符串范围比对**，它不验证 API 是否真的存在 |
| 启动没报错 → 能用 | 插件普遍用 `try/catch`、`typeof` 守卫做降级。**API 缺失时它会「激活成功」，但相应功能是死的** |
| 启动日志干净 → 客户端也没问题 | 客户端代码跑在浏览器里。实测有插件宿主端完全干净、客户端抛错导致 UI 根本不注册 |

所以：**读声明不够，看日志也不够。** 必须真实读一遍已装插件的源码、拿到宿主的真实 API 面，逐条对上。

## 三份产物，一个内核

同一个 Node 内核（`lib/`），三个入口。**它们的结论不可能不一致**——面板、命令行、对话工具消费的是同一份 `computeReport()` 结果。

| | 插件（进程内） | CLI | skill |
|---|---|---|---|
| 体检已装插件的宿主层 | ✅ 主职 | ✅ | 教 agent 何时调用 CLI |
| 体检客户端半边 | ✅ **独有** | ❌ 命令行永远看不到 | ❌ |
| 预检**尚未安装**的插件 | ❌ | ✅ **独有** | ❌ |
| 「装不上」（版本闸门拒绝） | ❌ | ✅ **独有** | ❌ |
| 宿主起不来时仍能工作 | ❌ 它自己也在里面 | ✅ **独有** | ❌ |
| 输出到终端 / CI | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ |
| 在对话里直接答 | 配合工具 ✅ | ❌ | ✅ |

> **插件的能力严格弱于 CLI，不是超集。** 所以本项目的文案里不会出现「装这个插件帮你做安装前检查」这种话——那是 CLI 的活。

## 快速开始

### 方式一：CLI（最完整，推荐先试）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lcy0121/dsh-plugin-compat-check.git
cd dsh-plugin-compat-check

# 体检某个 profile 里已装的插件
node bin/compat-check.mjs --nm ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop

# 有探针报告时，方法级结论才是「确定」
node bin/compat-check.mjs --nm ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop --probe /tmp/dsh-plugin-compat-check/probe-report.json --dsh-version 0.2.0-rc.2

# 仓库里自带一份可直接对照的运行时面（回归基准用）
node bin/compat-check.mjs --nm ~/.dsh/profiles/parityfix --probe tools/parity/fixtures/host-surface-parityfix.json --dsh-version 0.2.0-rc.2

# 机器可读 / 只要一行
node bin/compat-check.mjs --nm ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop --json
node bin/compat-check.mjs --nm ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop --quiet
```

`--nm` 既能给 `node_modules` 目录，也能给 profile 目录（会自动补 `node_modules`）。

| 选项 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `--nm <dir>` | **必需**。要体检的 `node_modules` 或 profile 目录 |
| `--probe <json>` | 宿主运行时面。**给了它，方法级结论才是「确定」**；不给则退回官方目录、降为「疑似」 |
| `--probe-boot` | **自己起一次宿主拿运行时面**（不必先有探针报告）。默认**不开** —— 它要复制 profile、跑 pnpm、起宿主（约 10~20 秒）。真实 desktop 上的效果：可用 9→**14**、不兼容 0，且发现从「疑似」变「确定」 |
| `--probe-timeout <秒>` / `--probe-keep-dir <dir>` | `--probe-boot` 的等待上限（默认 40）/ 把探针报告留一份到该目录（排查用） |
| `--dsh-version <v>` | 当前 DSH 版本（「声明与实测不符」这类结论的前提） |
| `--rules` / `--catalog` | 覆盖 `rules/` 下的规则表与官方目录 |
| `--no-baseline` | 不读写本机基线（CI / 一次性检查用） |
| `--baseline-file <path>` / `--dry-run` | 指定基线文件 / 算差分但不写 |
| `--json` / `--quiet` | 机器可读 / 只要一行总结论 |
| `--version` | 工具版本。`--json` 里是 `toolVersion`。**报结论时该带上它** —— 同一插件在不同版本下结论会变 |

**退出码**（`1` 与 `2` 只表示**插件的结论**）：

| 码 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `0` | 全部可用 |
| `1` | 有插件「部分可用」 |
| `2` | 有插件「不兼容」 |
| `3` | **这次体检本身没得出可信结论**（用法错误 / 目录不存在 / 工具自身出错） |

> `3` 为什么必须独立存在：把命令写错读成「这个插件不兼容」，会让用户去查**完全错误的方向**。

### 方式二：装成 DSH 插件（有面板）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:lcy0121/dsh-plugin-compat-check
```

装完在 **设置 → 内置插件 → 兼容性** 看到总览表；点开任一插件详情页，标题行会有它的结论角标，页面里是逐条发现。启动后几秒还会自动跑一次，并把「与上次相比变了没有」打进启动日志。

### 方式三：装 skill（让 agent 会用）

```bash
./dsh-plugin-compat-check.sh --install-skill
```

装到 `${DSH_AGENTS_HOME:-~/.agents}/skills/dsh-plugin-compat-check/SKILL.md`。有了它，你问「更新之后这插件还行吗」时 agent 会自己去跑，而不是让你去翻文档。

> ⚠️ **插件包内放 `SKILL.md` 不算数**——DSH 不扫描插件包内的文件。这就是方式二装完还要单独跑这一条的原因；插件形态会通过 `ctx.skills.registerProvider()` 自己注册，而这条命令是给**只用 CLI** 的用户准备的（他们拿不到插件注册的那份）。

### 方式四：端到端脚本（装包 + 起宿主 + 拿探针报告 + 判定）

```bash
./dsh-plugin-compat-check.sh <spec> [--keep] [--timeout 秒] [--json]
```

`<spec>` 与 `dsh plugin add` 完全一致：`dsh-keep-awake`、`github:owner/repo`、`file:/path/to/plugin`。

它比 CLI 多做三件事，也因此**能回答 CLI 回答不了的问题**：查 npm 身份（防撞名）、隔离安装（捕获版本闸门拒绝）、真实启动取探针报告（让方法级结论变成「确定」）。

| 选项 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `--keep` | 保留临时 profile 与现场，便于人工排查 |
| `--timeout N` | 启动等待秒数，默认 30 |
| `--json` | 机器可读输出 |
| `--install-skill` | 只装 skill，不体检（不需要判定内核） |
| `--force` | 配合 `--install-skill`，覆盖已存在的 skill |
| `--help` | 用法（**不查内核、直接退 0**）|

> **`--install-skill` 与体检互不干扰**：前者不需要内核；后者在内核缺失时会**直接报错退出**，不会降级成"只打印提取结果"——降级会给出一个看起来正常、**实际没有结论**的输出。

## 输出怎么读

```
插件数: 22    有运行时面: 是

结论: 可用 3    部分可用 19    不兼容 0

与上次相比:
  与上次相比没有任何变化

部分可用  dsh-keep-awake@0.2.0
     降级 / 宿主方法缺失  jobs.onJobsChanged  @ lib/index.js:591
       影响: 任务状态不再实时推送，插件退化为轮询（约 5 秒延迟）
       依据: 运行时里没有这个方法；规则表给出影响面
     功能失效 / 宿主方法缺失  settings.register  @ lib/index.js:466
       影响: 插件的设置页/设置项会消失
     客户端半边（命令行测不到，需界面验证）: locale, slots
     无证据可判（只出现名字，没有调用点）: timer
```

每个插件落进**恰好一类**去处，`services` 与去处集合必须相等（有不变式盯着）：

| 去处 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `finding` | 有结论，见上面的逐条发现 |
| `client-side` | 浏览器侧服务。**命令行测不到**，需要界面验证 |
| `self-provided` | 插件自己提供的服务，不是宿主服务 |
| `runtime-facility` | Cordis 上下文内置成员（`loader` / `effect` …），不是 DSH 服务 |
| `filtered` | 判为噪音/假阳性（JS 内置方法名、无来源变量…），不进结论 |
| `guarded` | **作者自己做了能力检测**，缺失时它有兜底 —— 报出来是假阳性 |
| `abstained` | 数据不足以判定（例如宿主目录对某服务没声明任何方法） |
| `no-calls` | 只出现过名字，没有任何调用点 —— **无证据可判，不是"没问题"** |

后两类是刻意区分出来的。`no-calls` 与 `abstained` 在别处都长得像"没问题"，而它们不是。

## 三档确定性（这是本工具的诚实机制）

| 档 | 什么时候 | 呈现 |
|---|---|---|
| **确定** | 有**运行时面**，或插件**自己声明过**这个依赖 | 不带标注 |
| **疑似** | 只有官方目录（**契约**目录，不是运行时面） | 标 `[疑似]` |
| 不进结论 | 既没声明、也不在目录里 | 记进 `filtered`，可查 |

> **官方目录 ≠ 运行时面。** 它对抽象服务（`jobs`）一个方法都不声明、对 `loader` 完全不收录、对 `settings` 声明的方法数也少于运行时实有。拿它断言「方法不存在」不够格叫确定，所以降级为「疑似」。
>
> 这不是缺陷，是**判不准时降级标注，而不是升格成确定**。

## 不做的事（与不撒谎同样重要）

- **不装包、不起子进程、不联网**（插件形态）。为拿一个版本号去破这条边界不值。
- **不猜**。拿不到 DSH 版本时 `dshVersion` 是 `null`，于是「声明与实测不符」这类结论**自动不成立**——而不是猜一个版本、凭空造出一条结论。
- **不把「不可比」说成「没问题」**。没有基线时会明说「还没比过」，损坏时会明说「读不出来，这次不比较」。
- **不用 LLM 判定**。严重度由分层默认档 + `rules/severity.json` 决定。

## 两条必须知道的边界

**1. 客户端这一层，命令行永远测不到。** 客户端代码在浏览器中执行。要确认它，只能看**界面上有没有出现该插件自己的 UI 元素**。本工具会**列出**客户端服务，但**不判定**它们——这是刻意的诚实，不是遗漏。（插件形态的面板也测不到这一层：它自己跑在宿主里。）

**2. 方法级判定建立在静态提取之上，有已知的误报来源。** 每一次真实缺陷都记在 [`docs/extraction-findings.md`](docs/extraction-findings.md)，包括已修的 18 项。拿不准时加 `--keep` 保留现场：

| 路径 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `/tmp/dsh-plugin-compat-check/boot.log` | 宿主启动日志（含 `did not activate`） |
| `/tmp/dsh-plugin-compat-check/static.json` | 从插件源码提取的服务与调用点（带 `file:line`） |
| `/tmp/dsh-plugin-compat-check/probe-report.json` | 宿主真实 API 面 |

## 目录结构

（受版本控制共 **144** 个文件：63 个是代码 / 文档 / 规则表，81 个是夹具数据
（`test/fixtures/micro/node_modules/` 69 个合成插件文件、`tools/parity/fixtures/hang-cycle/node_modules/` 5 个，
以及 1 个合成宿主运行时面）。下面把 63 个人工维护的条目**列全**，夹具内部按样例说明。）

```
dsh-plugin-compat-check/
├── README.md                   # 中文说明（本文件）
├── README.en.md                # 英文说明
├── README.ko.md                # 韩文说明
├── Plan.md                     # **开发计划与作业规程**：已锁定决策、里程碑、地雷清单、已实测的 DSH 契约
├── LICENSE                     # MIT
├── .gitignore
├── dsh-plugin-compat-check.sh  # 端到端编排：身份核对 → 隔离安装 → 提取 → 真实启动 → 判定
│
├── lib/                        # 内核：四个纯模块，三份产物共用同一份实现
│   ├── extract.mjs             #   静态提取：谁调用了什么（带 file:line 与证据形态）
│   ├── version.mjs             #   版本号的**唯一真源**（三个入口 + 报告都读它）
│   ├── verdict.mjs             #   判定：结论、三档确定性、每个服务的去处
│   ├── baseline.mjs            #   差分：与上次比变了没有、往哪个方向变（含徽标文案）
│   └── report.mjs              #   渲染：给人看的表（CLI 与对话工具同一口径）
│
├── bin/
│   └── compat-check.mjs        # CLI 入口：参数解析 / 退出码 / 表格与 JSON 两种渲染
│
├── plugin/                     # DSH 插件产物
│   ├── package.json            #   dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（platform 必须是字面量 "web"）
│   ├── cordis.patch.yml        #   插件装载清单
│   ├── index.js                #   宿主半边：自省 + 面板数据通道 + 对话工具 + skill 注册
│   ├── scripts/                #   prepack 把内核暂存进 kernel/，postpack 清掉
│   │   ├── stage-kernel.mjs    #     内核**从不进 git**（真源只有仓库根的 lib/ 与 rules/）
│   │   └── unstage-kernel.mjs
│   └── lib/
│       └── client.js           #   客户端半边：**预构建**（宿主不构建），跑在浏览器里
│
├── skill/                      # skill 产物
│   ├── SKILL.md                #   正文（frontmatter 只有 name / description）
│   └── README.md               #   注册机制说明：实测证据、扫描根、rank、frontmatter 规则
│
├── probe/                      # 诊断探针（以 file: 方式装进一次性 profile）
│   ├── package.json
│   ├── cordis.patch.yml
│   └── index.mjs               #   原型链枚举 + 作用域上下文探测；**只记结构，不记值**
│
├── rules/                      # 数据，不是逻辑
│   ├── README.md               #

plugins.description: One-click enable/disable switch for every model provider in DeepSeek Harness - disabled providers leave the model picker. DSH 模型提供商一键开关：在「设置 → 模型」每行「编辑」左侧放一个开关，关掉即从模型选择栏消失。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-provider-toggle

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue) ![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4c8bf5) ![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-brightgreen) ![runtime deps](https://img.shields.io/badge/runtime%20deps-none-success)

> **One-click enable/disable switch for every model provider in DeepSeek Harness**, sitting in **Settings → Models** right next to *Edit*.
> Turn a provider off and it leaves the composer's model picker; turn it back on and it returns.

![The switch to the left of Edit on every provider row](assets/placement-zoom.png)
*The switch lands to the left of the **Edit** button on each row (screenshot from the offline geometry harness — all 3 rows pass).*

```
Settings → Models
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ opencode-go                   ●   ( )  Edit  Delete  │  ← switch, left of Edit
│                                   ↑                  │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Install

One line from GitHub:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:DeepseekDays/dsh-provider-toggle
```

(use your own profile name instead of `desktop` if different).

From a checkout — same three steps, but **without running pnpm**:

```sh
node install.mjs              # install or repair
node install.mjs --dry        # show what would change
node install.mjs --uninstall  # uninstall (keeps the folder)
```

`install.mjs` does exactly three things (it never runs pnpm, so it will not rebuild
`node_modules` and cannot interrupt a live session): create a directory junction, add a
`link:` dependency to the profile's `package.json`, and append the package name to
`dsh.profile.bundles`. It writes a `.bak-provider-toggle-*` backup before touching the
manifest. The profile defaults to `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`; set `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` to
target another one.

Then **fully quit DSH, tray included, and start it again** — bundle lists and the browser
module table are read at startup, so HMR will not pick up a new package.

## How it works

There is exactly one load-bearing fact: **DSH's model picker only renders provider groups
that have at least one model.**

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller`'s `buildModelCatalog()` contains

```js
groups.filter(group => group.models.length > 0)
```

So the plugin hooks in as lightly as possible — by wrapping `ctx.llm.listModels()`:

| Half | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| host | `index.js` | A disabled provider route makes `listModels()` return `[]` → the group is dropped → it disappears from the picker |
| client | `client.js` | Renders `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`' `<Switch>` into the `settings.models.provider-card` keyed slot; reads and writes through the existing `ctx.remote.settings` |

**It only affects the catalog and the picker, never routing.** `dsh-llm` says so itself:
*"Core routing accepts unlisted model ids; catalog-driven entry points such as the GUI may
require membership."* Sessions already using one of these models keep working; the model
simply stops being offered in the picker.

### Where the state lives

In the plugin's own settings namespace (`Config.disabled`, marked `.volatile()`):

- It goes through DSH's native settings service → persisted into the profile's
  **`cordis.patch.yml`** (the `id: dsh-provider-toggle` entry).
- The browser half uses `ctx.remote.settings.describe() / mutate()` directly — no custom
  remote endpoint.
- Editing any provider in Settings makes DSH rewrite the whole `cordis.patch.yml`, but it
  rewrites from in-memory state and our value is already in memory, so **it is not clobbered**.
- `.volatile()` makes changes **take effect hot**: the loader emits
  `loader/volatile-update`, the plugin broadcasts `llm/adapters-updated`, and the browser
  reloads the model catalog on the spot. **Toggling never needs a DSH restart.**

### Why every provider is one registration

`settings.models.provider-card` is a **keyed** slot: rendering matches a registration's
`key` against `renderSlot(name, props, { entryKey: row.entry.settingsNs })`. All of pi-ai's
routes (DeepSeek / openai / opencode-go / custom relays…) **share the same settingsNs** —
they differ only by `settingsPath: ["providers", <route>]`. So **one keyed registration
renders once per row**, with that row's `provider` in props. Namespaces of their own (such
as `deepseek-account`) get a second registration.

### How the position is decided

Slot content renders **below** rowHead by default (inside the same card). To sit left of
*Edit*, the component measures `li` / `[class*="rowHead"]` / `[class*="rowActions"]` with
`getBoundingClientRect()` after mount and absolutely positions itself there (class names are
CSS Module hashes, hence the `[class*=...]` substring selectors). **If it cannot measure, it
falls back to inline layout — the feature keeps working.**

## Requirements and compatibility

- A DSH that provides the `settings.models.provider-card` keyed slot and
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` (tested against DSH Desktop `2.0.17` /
  `dsh-base` `0.2.0-rc.2`).
- Declares `dsh.bundle` in `package.json`, so it installs with plain `dsh plugin add`.
- **No kernel files are modified.** The plugin wraps `ctx.llm.listModels()` at runtime and
  restores it on unload (reference-counted, so repeated apply/unload does not stack wrappers).
- **Coexists with `dsh-ofm-model-manager`** (per-model enable/disable and renaming). Both
  wrap the same `listModels`, both are reference-counted, and their preference keys are
  independent.
- Runtime dependencies: **none**.

## Development

```sh
node test-filter.mjs              # host logic: 16 assertions
node test-client.mjs              # client logic: 13 assertions
node preview/placement-check.mjs  # layout geometry + screenshot
```

Three offline harnesses — no DSH session, no network required for the first two:

| File | Covers |
| --- | --- |
| `test-filter.mjs` | host logic: does a disabled provider really leave the catalog, does re-enabling restore it, does unload revert, does a repeated apply stack, the fallback path when the config is not a ref |
| `test-client.mjs` | loads `client.js` with a minimal fake React: slot registration shape, `Switch` state, the exact `mutate` arguments, silent no-render when the namespace is unavailable |
| `preview/placement-check.mjs` | geometry: extracts the **real CSS** and the **real `placeSwitch()`** from a DSH installation, rebuilds the DOM, measures through local Edge + CDP and screenshots |

The suites re-implement the expected behaviour (they replicate DSH's
`groups.filter(group => group.models.length > 0)` rather than calling the code under test)
so they cannot pass by agreeing with themselves. The placement harness needs `DSH_APP_DIR`
(default `F:/DSH/DSH Desktop/resources/app`) and `EDGE_PATH`.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause / fix |
| --- | --- |
| No switch appears at all | The bundle was not read: **fully quit DSH (tray included) and start again**. Confirm the package name is in `dsh.profile.bundles`. |
| The switch renders inline instead of left of *Edit* | Measurement failed — DSH probably changed the Settings row structure (no more `rowHead` / `rowActions` class substrings). The feature still works. |
| Flipping the switch does nothing | The settings namespace is not exposed (check the console for `settings namespace "dsh-provider-toggle" is not exposed`), or the write was rejected because the field is not volatile. |
| A provider you disabled vanished | That is the intended behaviour. To recover: Settings → Models → flip it back, or clear `config.disabled` in the `id: dsh-provider-toggle` entry of the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. |

## Known limits

- **No switch for `deepseek-account`.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-models` calls
  `remote.session.modelCatalog()` once while building the row list and then runs
  `rows.filter(row => row.entry.provider !== "deepseek-account" || row.accountAvailable === true)`
  — so once this provider is dropped from the catalog, **its own row disappears too** and
  there is no UI left to turn it back

plugins.description: OpenCode Go quota in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar foot: one 42px cell plus a hover popover with the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, each carrying a usage bar, an elapsed-time marker, the remaining share and a reset countdown.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-go-quota

**English** — OpenCode Go quota in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar foot, directly under the workspace/session list. One 42px cell shows the most constrained window; hovering or clicking opens a popover with the rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, each carrying a usage bar, an elapsed-time marker (so you can tell whether you are burning faster than the clock), the remaining share and a reset countdown. A Host half serves `GET /api/opencode-go-quota` from OpenCode's official usage endpoint (`https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`) using the key already in the DSH credential store, so the key never reaches the browser. The collapsed 56px rail shows the percentage as a number.

---

在 DeepSeek Harness 网页版**左侧边栏最底部**（「工作区 / 会话列表」下方、与「设置」同排）显示
**OpenCode Go 订阅额度**的 DSH 插件。

## 显示内容

| 区域 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 展开的侧边栏 | **一行 42px 的单元格**：`◯ OpenCode Go ………… 本月 18%`。左边的小圆环本身就是进度指示，右边是最紧张那一档的已用百分比 |
| 收起的侧边栏（56px 竖条） | 一个 36px 圆形按钮，直接显示百分比数字 |
| 悬停 / 点击 | 弹出一个 320px 浮层：每一档一行，含 6px 用量条、**时间进度标记**（窗口已经过去多少，用来判断你是用得比时间快还是慢）、剩余百分比与重置倒计时 |
| 浮层里的「刷新」 | 立即重新拉取（绕过 Host 端 30 秒缓存） |

浮层里每档的三行含义：

```
5 小时窗口                        已用 8%
▓▓▓░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░   ← 填充=已用；竖线=时间进度
剩余 92%            时间已过 46%      2 小时 12 分钟后重置
```

* 竖线在填充右边 → 你比时间用得慢，安全；竖线在填充左边 → 比时间快，要收着点。
* `本月` 的时间进度带 `≈`，因为计费周期的起点不在接口里，是按「重置时间往前推一个自然月」估算的；`5 小时窗口` 和 `本周` 是精确值（5 小时 / 7 天）。

颜色：`< 70%` 品牌蓝，`70%–89%` 黄色，`≥ 90%` 红色，取不到数据显示为灰色 `--`。

## 数据来源

* Host 半边 `GET /api/opencode-go-quota`（同源、拒绝跨站调用）。
* 上游是 OpenCode Go 官方额度接口 `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`，
  响应形如：

  ```json
  {"usage":{
    "rolling":{"status":"ok","percent":5,"resetsAt":"2026-10-07T06:00:12.000Z"},
    "weekly":{"status":"ok","percent":5,"resetsAt":"2026-10-12T00:00:00.000Z"},
    "monthly":{"status":"ok","percent":17,"resetsAt":"2026-10-28T11:29:15.000Z"}}}
  ```

* 鉴权用你**已经存好**的凭据 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`（就是 `opencode-go`
  provider 在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的那一个）。
  **API Key 只留在 Host 进程，永远不会下发到浏览器。**
* 页面每 **60 秒**自动刷新一次；Host 端另有 30 秒缓存，点击卡片可立即强制刷新。
* 上游返回 `cache-control: no-store`，即接口本身不做缓存；数字会随着你（或任何其他机器）正在使用 OpenCode Go 而实时上涨。
* 三档的官方含义（与 OpenCode 面板一致）：`rolling` = 滚动 5 小时窗口、`weekly` = 本周（周一 UTC 重置）、`monthly` = 当前计费周期。接口数字是**全账号**口径，包含其他机器的用量。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-opencode-go-quota/
├── package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（platform: web, immediately）
├── cordis.patch.yml    # 插入 id: opencode-go-quota 的 loader 行
├── index.js            # Host 半边：/api/opencode-go-quota 路由
├── client.js           # Client 半边：window.__ModuleLoader__ 工厂，注册进 sidebar.footer.action
├── locale/{en,zh}.json # 插件列表里显示的标题与说明
├── icon.svg            # 插件卡片图标
└── README.md
```

## 安装 / 卸载

安装（已在本机 desktop profile 装好）：

```
plugin_manager  action=install_bundle  target=<本目录或 file:/绝对路径>
```

卸载：

```
plugin_manager  action=remove_bundle   target=dsh-opencode-go-quota
```

临时停用：`plugin_manager action=set_plugin target=opencode-go-quota enabled=false`。

安装后无需重启即可生效；若浏览器页面没有立刻出现，刷新一次页面即可。

## 排查

* 卡片显示红色错误文字：把鼠标停在上面看完整信息。
* `凭据 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY 未配置` → 在「设置 → 模型」里给 `opencode-go` 填 API Key。
* `额度接口返回 401` → Key 失效或已轮换，重新填一次。
* 直接验证 Host 半边：

  ```bash
  curl -s http://127.0.0.1:19387/api/opencode-go-quota
  ```

plugins.description: DSH 插件：侧栏内联的「置顶」会话分组（原生度量 + 就地搜索）。A pinned-session group in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pinned-sessions

> npm package: **`@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions`** · repo: `dsh-pinned-sessions`
>
> A **pinned-session group in the sidebar** for DeepSeek Harness: 「置顶」 sits where
> a Workspace group sits — a 34px header with an **outline** pin glyph, a count and
> a search button, and 32px session rows under it for every pinned session, across
> all workspaces. Pin enough of them and you can search right there.

[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

## What it does

DSH already pins sessions (hover a row → pin glyph, or right-click → 「置顶会话」),
but the result is only a re-order **inside that session's own workspace group**: a
pinned session still scrolls away when you switch workspaces, collapse groups, or
drown in a long list.

This plugin gives the pinned set its own group, above the Workspace browser:

```
插件
自动化任务
工作区                        ← the native section header
置顶  1  dsh-pinned-sessions v0.4.0  🔍   ← this plugin, inside the list
   插件笔记：dsh-cost-…   默认工作区   4 小时前
默认工作区
   新会话
   …
```

With the search open (the count becomes `matched/total`):

```
置顶  1/3  dsh-pinned-sessions v0.4.0  ✕
   [ 搜索置顶会话              ]
   插件笔记：dsh-cost-…   4 小时前
```

- rows are drawn with the **native session-row metrics** (32px rows, 14px titles,
  10px meta, the same hover wash and hover-revealed actions), so the group is
  visually indistinguishable from a workspace group;
- the group is mounted **inside the native list's own scroll container**, as its
  first item: it sits under the 「工作区」 header with the same scrollbar as the
  groups below, never squeezes them, and steps aside while the list shows search
  results;
- each row shows **which workspace it belongs to** (`默认工作区`) and carries the
  session's own status dot — running (blue) or finished-but-unopened (green) — from
  the real session-status hook; title, workspace and time also ride the row tooltip;
- **Settings → 通用** has a 「置顶会话区」 switch, so the group can be turned off
  without editing anything;
- the header carries the plugin's **npm identity** — `dsh-pinned-sessions v0.4.0` —
  as a muted chip that links to
  [`@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions)
  on npm (`target="_blank"`; the desktop shell turns that into `shell.openExternal`,
  so it opens in your browser instead of inside the app). The chip shows the
  **unscoped** name because the sidebar is 256px wide; its tooltip/aria-label carry
  the full scoped name, and clicking it never toggles the group;
- the header's **outline** pin matches the line-icon style of the sidebar entries
  above it (插件 / 自动化任务); a row's own pin marker stays filled, keeping
  "state" distinct from "navigation";
- clicking a row opens that session; hovering one reveals 「取消置顶」;
- the header's 🔍 filters this group in place: title match, case-insensitive,
  surrounding whitespace ignored; opening the search expands the group, and Esc or
  a second click closes it and clears the query; a query with no match gets its own
  line, distinct from the "nothing pinned yet" hint;
- the header is a disclosure control — click to collapse, and the choice survives
  reloads. When nothing is pinned the group shows a one-line hint instead of rows;
- running sessions keep the native state dot; archived pins are hidden with a
  count note; subagent sessions never appear.

It owns **no new state**: pinning is the Host capability the native Workspace
browser already ships (`dsh-api-workspace-controller` → `workspaces.pinSession` /
`unpinSession`, persisted in the `workspace` storage unit), so the sidebar and the
group always agree — pin with either one and the other updates immediately.

## How it is mounted

The sidebar's browsing region between the global panel rows and the foot is
declared as **one `single` slot** (`sidebar.workspaces`) owned by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace`, and it exposes no "extra group" seat:

| seat | owner | what it holds |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sidebar.panellist` (list) | ui-sidebar | the global panel rows (插件, 自动化任务, …) — a row is a button, not a group |
| `sidebar.workspaces` (single) | ui-workspace | the whole browsing region: header, search, tree, menus |

Shadowing `sidebar.workspaces` would mean reimplementing the entire browser
(search, flat/grouped views, drag ordering, menus, hover cards, archive flow), so
instead this plugin mounts **next to the renderer's own outlet anchor**
(`div[data-slot="sidebar.workspaces"]`, `display: contents`) as its previous
sibling inside the region, and portals the group into that host node:

- nothing is ever inserted into the native component's DOM subtree;
- the host node is `flex: none`, so the native browser keeps `flex: 1` and simply
  gets a little less height — the pinned group stays put while the list scrolls;
- the anchor is re-resolved through a throttled `MutationObserver`, so the group
  survives re-renders and sidebar collapse/expand;
- if the anchor ever disappears (a future DSH changes the sidebar), the plugin
  renders nothing instead of breaking anything.

## Feedback

Bugs and ideas: [Issues](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-pinned-sessions/issues).

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions
```

The package is dual-face (`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`): the Loader row
brings up the no-op Host half, and the browser half arrives through
`exports["./client"]`.

### Local development (this checkout)

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
# 1) make the package resolvable (pnpm hard-links a directory dependency, so a
#    symlink keeps edits live). The install name comes from the package's own
#    package.json, so a scoped package lands under node_modules/@vfvrpq/:
pnpm add file:/path/to/dsh-pinned-sessions     # or hand-edit package.json
ln -sfn /path/to/dsh-pinned-sessions node_modules/@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions
# 2) activate the row in your own patch layer (hot: the loader watches it)
cat >> cordis.patch.yml <<'YAML'
- insert:
    - id: dsh-pinned-sessions
      name: '@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions'
YAML
```

Then **reload the Web UI** (⌘R / F5). The boot graph is rebuilt per page load, so
an edited `lib/client.js` shows up on the next reload — no application restart.
Do **not** also add `@vfvrpq/dsh-pinned-sessions` to `dsh.profile.bundles` at the
same time: `insert` is append-only and never de-duplicates ids, so the plugin
would be mounted twice and its slot registrations would collide. (Appending that
row to a patch file that still holds the template's bare `[]` produces invalid
YAML and is silently ignored — `[]` plus a sequence is two documents in one file.)

## Develop

`lib/client.js` is the browser bundle, written by hand in the same
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` shape the build emits — plain JS
with `react.createElement`, no build step, no JSX. `apply(ctx)` registers exactly
one entry:

| registration | slot | id |
| --- | --- | --- |
| sidebar group (portals into the sidebar) | `shell.overlay` (list) | `pinned-sessions-section` |

Client services it injects: `slots`, `sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiWorkspace`,
`locale`. It reads the two stores (`sessions.list`, `workspaces.list`) through
`useSyncExternalStore` and never writes to them directly.

### Checks

```sh
<bundled node> test/bundle-check.mjs
```

Registers the bundle against a fake `window.__ModuleLoader__`, materializes the
factory with stub `require`, runs `apply()` against a fake Client Context and
renders the group with a hook shim — asserting the entry id, the dictionaries'
key parity, the anchor selector, pin order, the count, the running dot, the
unpin toggle (and that it does not also open the row), collapse, the empty hint,
the archived note, subagent filtering, the English copy, and the npm chip (its
text, its `href`, `target`/`rel`, and that clicking it does not toggle the group).

Because a client bundle cannot read its own manifest, `lib/client.js` repeats the
package name and version (`PACKAGE_NAME` / `PACKAGE_VERSION`). The chip checks
compare them against `package.json`, so a version bump that forgets the bundle
fails the suite instead of shipping a stale chip.

The DOM-mounting

plugins.description: Doubao Search (Volcengine) web search provider for DeepSeek Harness — makes the standard web_search tool return real excerpts, not just titles and links.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-doubao

Give DeepSeek Harness's standard **`web_search`** tool a search backend that returns
**real excerpts**, not just titles and links.

This is a **search provider plugin** for the harness's web capability seam (`ctx.web`).
It registers a Doubao Search (Volcengine) backend and points the seam at it, so the
model-facing tool `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web` keeps working unchanged — only the
backend behind it changes.

English | [中文](./README.zh.md)

---

## Why this exists

The harness ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek`, which performs search by
asking a model to call the **server-side `web_search` tool** over an
Anthropic-compatible Messages API. That route works, but the results it can surface
carry only a **title and a URL** — the response has no citation excerpts, so the
normalized `sources[].snippet` is always empty.

The Doubao Search API is a plain search endpoint that returns structured results,
including a per-result body. This plugin maps that body onto `snippet`, so every
source arrives with text the model can actually read and cite:

| | model-side `web_search` tool | this plugin (Doubao Search API) |
|---|---|---|
| `sources[].title` / `.url` | ✅ | ✅ |
| `sources[].snippet` | ❌ always empty | ✅ real excerpt per source |
| `sources[].publishedAt` | sometimes the `1970-01-01` epoch sentinel | real date, sentinel filtered out |
| Cost per search | one extra model turn (thousands of tokens) | one API call, no model tokens |
| Typical latency | 6–14 s | ~0.2–0.6 s |

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` (the `ctx.web` seam's provider API).
- Node.js `>= 22`.
- A **Volcengine API key**. An **Agent Plan** key works here and draws on the plan's
  AFP quota — the official Agent Plan docs describe Doubao Search as the plan's search
  service, callable with the plan's dedicated API key. A key from an unrelated
  Volcengine product will authenticate but is not covered by the plan.

The endpoint defaults to `https://open.feedcoopapi.com/search_api/web_search`, which is
the public Doubao Search URL. No configuration is needed to reach it.

## Install

```sh
# straight from this repository
dsh plugin --profile web add github:gilsaia/dsh-web-search-doubao

# or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-web-search-doubao
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding it also adds it to the profile's
bundle list, and its patch selects this provider:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: web-search-doubao
      name: 'dsh-web-search-doubao'

- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: doubao
    fetchProvider: http
```

`fetchProvider` is restated because a row patch **replaces** the targeted row's whole
`config`; omitting it would unset the fetch provider and break `web_fetch`.

> **About the `Issues with peer dependencies found` warning:** it is expected. The
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages this plugin imports are provided by the harness itself
> at load time rather than installed into the profile, so pnpm reports them as missing
> peers. The harness resolves them when it mounts the plugin.

Restart the harness afterwards (or reload the profile), then run a search.

## Configure it in the GUI

The plugin ships a **client half**. After one restart it adds a **联网搜索 (Web search)**
page to the harness settings sidebar, and everything below can be done there:

- **API Key** — typed into a password field and written through the harness credentials
  domain under the reference the form names. The literal never enters a settings file,
  and the page only learns whether a key is *configured*, not what it is.
- **Every config field** — endpoint, search type, result count, time range, authority
  filter, query rewriting, summary toggle. Fields you changed show **未保存**; fields the
  user layer overrides show **已覆盖** with a one-click **恢复默认**.
- **Save** applies one revision-fenced write; **撤销** discards the staged edits.

A save takes effect on the next search — no restart needed for either the config or the
key. The page mounts only while the host serves the `web-search-doubao` settings
namespace, so a deployment without the plugin shows no trace of it.

## Provide the key without the GUI

The plugin requires a key. It resolves one in this order:

1. the literal **`apiKey`** config value;
2. the credential named by **`apiKeyEnv`** (default `ARK_API_KEY`), read through the
   harness credentials service, falling back to the launching environment.

So either export it:

```sh
export ARK_API_KEY=...        # then start the harness
```

or set it in the plugin's config in the profile's patch layer:

```yaml
- id: web-search-doubao
  config:
    apiKey: '...'             # a secret; prefer apiKeyEnv so no key enters a config file
```

> If the profile patch is still the shipped default, it contains a bare `[]`. Replace that
> `[]` with your entries — appending a `- id:` item after it makes the file two YAML
> documents and the harness refuses to parse the overlay.

A missing key fails the search with `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` and a message
naming the reference that was consulted — it never silently returns zero results.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | string (secret) | — | Literal API key. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | credential ref | `ARK_API_KEY` | Credential reference resolved per search. |
| `baseURL` | string | Doubao Search URL | Full endpoint; override for a proxy or a different region. |
| `searchType` | `web` \| `image` | `web` | `image` returns image results instead of pages. |
| `maxResults` | 1–50 | `10` | Result count when a request carries no bound. |
| `timeRange` | string | — | `OneDay` / `OneWeek` / `OneMonth` / `OneYear`, or `YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD`. |
| `authLevel` | 0–2 | `0` | `1` restricts to authoritative sources. Web searches only. |
| `queryRewrite` | boolean | `false` | Let the service rewrite a conversational query into a search-shaped one. |
| `needSummary` | boolean | `true` | Request the excerpt surfaced as `snippet`. Turning this off empties `snippet`. |

`baseURL` can also be overridden with the `DOUBAO_SEARCH_BASE_URL` environment variable.

Every field is read **per search**, so a settings change applies to the next search
without restarting the harness.

## Reverting

Remove the `- id: web` block from `cordis.patch.yml` (or override it in your own patch
layer, which is applied after every bundle layer) to keep the default provider. The
plugin stays registered and selectable, just unused:

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: deepseek-official
    fetchProvider: http
```

## Verify

```sh
# pure-function and plugin-contract tests: no network, no key
npm test

# live check against the real API; asserts sources carry snippets
ARK_API_KEY=... npm run test:live
```

To confirm the composition without booting:

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A4 'id: web$'
# searchProvider: doubao
# fetchProvider: http
```

## How it works

- `provider.js` — `DoubaoSearchProvider`, the wire format, result mapping, and error
  translation. It uses the native `fetch` client and does **not** go through `ctx.llm`.
- `index.js` — the Cordis plugin: `name`, `inject: ['web']`, the `Config` schema, and
  `apply()`, which registers the provider into the seam.
- `client/client.js` — the browser half, declared as `dsh.client` and served by the host
  under `/plugins`. Hand-authored against the loader's client-bundle envelope, so it
  needs no build step and requires only the platform `react`. Every read and write goes
  through the documented Remote namespaces (`settings.describe` / `settings.mutate` /
  `credentials.describe` / `credentials.set`).
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch that mounts the plugin and selects it.

Two details worth knowing if you fork it:

- The API answers failures with **HTTP 200** and an `Error` object under
  `ResponseMetadata`, so a successful status code is not enough — the body is checked
  too.
- The API emits an epoch sentinel (`1970-01-01T08:00:00+08:00`) for pages whose crawl
  time is unknown. That is filtered out rather than surfaced as a publication date.

## Compatibility

`@de

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin to use OpenAI decisions API
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-decisions-classifiers

OpenAI **Decisions API** classifiers for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The Decisions API (`POST /v1/decisions`, model `gpt-6-luna`) answers typed questions about text
and images instead of generating prose: a **predicate** returns the probability that a condition
holds, a **choice** returns one of your options with the full probability distribution, and a
**score** returns a probability-weighted average over ordered levels. This plugin puts that
capability in four places.

| Surface | What it gives you |
| --- | --- |
| Agent tools | `decisions_classify` (one built-in classifier), `decisions_ask` (arbitrary typed questions, up to ~10 per request), `decisions_status` |
| Cordis service | `decisionsClassifiers` — `listPresets()`, `classify()`, `ask()`, `status()` for other plugins |
| Opt-in call gate | Classify every `run_code`/`bash`/`write`/`edit` call before it executes and deny the flagged ones |
| Advice card | A "classifier opinion" card beside `ask_user_question` multiple-choice prompts, with one click to adopt |

## Classifier library

| id | type | answers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `moderation` | predicate | Does this content violate a standard acceptable-use policy? |
| `prompt-injection` | predicate | Does this text try to manipulate an AI system rather than inform a reader? |
| `dangerous-command` | predicate | Does this command irreversibly destroy data or change machine-wide state? |
| `pii` | predicate | Does this text identify a real individual? |
| `relevance` | predicate | Is this passage relevant to the stated query? (pass `context`) |
| `severity` | score | Cosmetic / workaround available / fully blocked |
| `intent` | choice | billing / technical / shipping / other |

Anything else goes through `decisions_ask`, which takes the wire question types directly.

## Setup

1. Install the bundle (see below).
2. Open **Settings → Decisions Classifiers**, paste an OpenAI API key, and press **Store key**.
   The key is written through the DSH credential seam as `OPENAI_API_KEY` (or the env name you
   set) and is never read back by the page. `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the process environment or a
   `.env` file works too.
3. Press **Test connection**.

The call gate is **off by default**: installing this plugin changes no agent behaviour until you
turn it on.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-decisions-classifiers
```

or through the Harness plugin manager with the package directory as the target.

## Configuration

Every field is settable from the Settings page (persisted to
`~/.dsh/decisions-classifiers/config.json`) and overridable from the bundle row; live edits win.
Pin a deployment in `cordis.patch.yml`.

| key | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | endpoint base; `/decisions` is appended |
| `model` | `gpt-6-luna` | the only model the Decisions API serves today |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `OPENAI_API_KEY` | credential-seam reference name |
| `timeoutMs` | `60000` | per-request budget |
| `defaultThreshold` | `0.5` | predicate cut-off when a preset does not fix one |
| `advisorEnabled` | `true` | the advice card |
| `gateEnabled` | `false` | the pre-execution gate |
| `gatePreset` | `dangerous-command` | classifier the gate runs |
| `gateThreshold` | `0.5` | gate cut-off |
| `gateDecision` | `deny` | `deny` or `escalate` |
| `systemPromptSection` | `true` | tell the agent the classifiers exist |

## What the numbers mean

The endpoint returns a probability distribution over a support, then projects it: `choice` takes
the argmax, `score` takes the expectation of the zero-based level index, and `predicate` has
nothing to project. Those projections are where the interpretation lives, and they are not
equally portable.

| type | support comes from | scalar you get | portable? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predicate` | the world (true/false) | `probability` | **yes** — the one number that travels |
| `choice` | **your options list** | `choice` (argmax) | no — menu-dependent |
| `score` | **your ordered levels** | `score` = E[index] | no — level-dependent, and metric-imposing |

**`predicate` is the only portable scalar.** It is a Bernoulli parameter, so it is calibratable
against realized outcomes (reliability diagrams, Brier score) and thresholdable against a cost
rule. One caveat matters more than it looks: the endpoint accepts *any* input, so many predicates
are subjective ("is this code maintainable?"). There, `probability` is not a property of the
world — it is a marginal over a rule set nobody wrote. Calibration still works, but its referent
becomes *your* raters instead of reality: it licenses "consistent with our standard", never
"true".

**`choice` distributions are menu-dependent.** The support is your options list, so relabeling
the menu moves the numbers while the world stays put. Measured on one fixed top category, with
only the tail split ever more finely:

| menu | max p | sum p² | top-2 gap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2-way [0.80, 0.20] | 0.8000 | 0.6800 | 0.6000 |
| 4-way [0.80, 0.09, 0.06, 0.05] | 0.8000 | 0.6542 | 0.7100 |

Two candidate concentration measures move in **opposite directions** under that relabeling. So a
4-option and a 2-option question in the same batch are not comparable on any confidence number,
and the interpretable signal is the **top-2 margin** — how close the routing is to a coin flip.

**`score` is an ordinal position presented as an interval.** Levels carry only `label` and
`description`; the API assigns indices 0..n-1 by position, with no client-supplied weight or
value. E[index] is meaningful only if your levels are equally spaced in the quantity you care
about — usually false for severity, where cosmetic→workaround is a far smaller real jump than
workaround→blocked. Prefer thresholding on `P(level >= k)` over the returned `probabilities`:
that needs no metric assumption.

**`confidence` is a concentration index, not a probability.** The guide calls it a separate field
and never defines it, and it cannot be recovered from the published examples: sum p² and the
top-2 gap both fit them to within ~0.01 while disagreeing in *sign* under relabeling. It is also
not comparable across questions with different option counts. Read `probabilities` directly and
compute your own statistic with weights you know.

### Where the rubric actually lives

No answer type removes the standard you were supposed to specify; they relocate it.

| type | where the standard lives | failure mode | detectable? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `predicate` (observable) | the world | estimation error | yes — reliability |
| `predicate` (subjective) | model prior + prompt | **definition ambiguity** | mostly invisible |
| `choice` | **your options list** | menu sensitivity | yes — measurable |
| `score` | your levels list | imposed equidistance | visible, magnitude unmeasurable |

A `choice` externalizes the standard — readable, diffable, and its sensitivity is measurable. A
subjective `predicate` internalizes it, which makes it *less* auditable, not more objective. And
a subjective `probability` is a mixture over provenance channels with unknown weights: the
model's prior over "maintainable" is built from scraped text, paid annotation, users' own chat
inputs and corrections, and automatic outcome signals such as test pass/fail — each with
different epistemic standing. That is the practical reason "does the test pass" is trustworthy
and "is this maintainable" is not: only the first has a rubric in the loop.

### Auditability

Every `decisions_classify` verdict carries the exact `question` that was sent — type, name,
instructions, and the choices or levels — and `decisions_ask` returns the questions as
normalized and sent. For a subjective predicate that instruction text is the only part of the
decision with a knowable provenance, so a verdict without it cannot be reviewed after the fact.
The full wire request is deliberately not echoed: it can carry inlined base64 images.

- **Images must be inline base64.** The endpo

# Instruction Files & Agent Profiles for DeepSeek Harness

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [Security](SECURITY.md)

Manage **workspace instructions, agent identities, and per-profile defaults** in DSH without replacing the host's native agent, permissions, or session history.

## Features

- Opt-in Markdown prompt sections: `IDENTITY.md`, `SOUL.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `TOOLS.md`, `USER.md`, and `MEMORY.md`.
- Optional replacement of the native identity section with `IDENTITY.md`; other named prompt sections are **plugin-defined**, not native DSH section names.
- Reloads changed workspace instructions on the next model step while avoiding duplicate injection.
- Manages custom agent profiles with workspace, model and permission defaults for **new** sessions.
- Cooperates with [Dream & Memory](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-memory-dreaming) and [Channel Core](https://github.com/Kerberos255/dsh-channel-core) to avoid untrusted private memory injection.

## Install

Requires a compatible DSH host; check [package.json](package.json) for runtime and peer dependencies.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Kerberos255/dsh-instruction-files
```

Replace the example profile with yours; restart after installation or code updates.

## Quick start

1. Open **Settings → Plugins → Instruction Files & Profiles**.
2. Select the workspace and enable the master workspace-prompt option (off by default).
3. Add only the Markdown files you intend to use, then enable each corresponding section.
4. Optionally create a custom agent profile with its own **new-session** model/permission defaults.

Example workspace root:

```text
workspace/
  IDENTITY.md
  SOUL.md
  AGENTS.md
  TOOLS.md
  USER.md
  MEMORY.md
```

`IDENTITY.md` controls identity; `SOUL.md` holds behavior/style preferences. `MEMORY.md` is sensitive: in private channels, access must pass owner verification and the plugin's memory boundary. Changing files does not retroactively rewrite a running model request.

## Notes and tests

Changing a default affects new sessions, **not existing conversations**. Disabled sections fall back to native DSH behavior. The plugin does not create user instruction files or evaluate template expressions.

Run `npm test` for standalone prompt/memory-filter checks. Config template: [config.example.json](config.example.json).

MIT licensed. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).
